source: DHM Islamic Studies Level 1 · lesson 18. Exercises reused from the lesson.
topic: Abdul-Muttalib, Abu Talib, and the monk Bahira

learn.en: After his mother died, his grandfather Abdul-Muttalib, the head of the Hashimi clan, looked after him with great love.
learn.title: His grandfather

learn.en: When he was eight, his grandfather died, and his uncle Abu Talib took care of him — loving him more than his own sons.
learn.title: His uncle

learn.en: At twelve, he travelled with Abu Talib's trade caravan to Syria.
learn.title: A trip to Syria

learn.en: In Busra, a monk named Bahira recognised him as the coming Last Prophet and told Abu Talib to take special care of him.
learn.title: Bahira the monk

learn.en: “And We have not sent you except as a mercy to the worlds.” (Qur'an 21:107)
learn.title: A mercy to the worlds

quiz.en: Who looked after him after his grandfather died?
Where did the caravan go when he was twelve?
Who recognised him as the Last Prophet?
True or false? Abu Talib loved him more than his own sons.

think.q: The Prophet ﷺ is called “a mercy to the worlds”. What do you think that means?
think.a: He brought kindness and guidance to everyone — people, animals, the whole world.

parents.summary: Cared for by his grandfather, then his uncle Abu Talib; at twelve the monk Bahira recognised him as the Last Prophet.
parents.tip: Draw a family tree of the Prophet ﷺ together: Abdul-Muttalib, Abdullah, Aminah, Abu Talib.
